page_title: UDI 2-2 SAS | Udinese v Sassuolo 17/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Sassuolo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+3' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+1' It will be a substitution. Isaac Success (Udinese) is ready to enter the pitch as Lorenzo Lucca walks off.
90+1' Substitution. Walace makes his way off the pitch and Oier Zarraga (Udinese) comes on as his replacement.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Adam Masina (Udinese) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
89' Here is a change. Armand Lauriente is going off and Alessio Dionisi gives the last tactical orders to Emil Konradsen Ceide (Sassuolo).
88' 2 - 2 Goal! Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) puts the ball into the middle of the goal past the outstretched arm of Marco Silvestri.
88' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
88' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) jumps into a tackle and Gianluca Manganiello signals a foul. Sassuolo are awarded a penalty kick!
85' Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) outjumps his marker from the resulting set piece and produces a powerful header that hits the left post. Unlucky!
84' Sassuolo will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
84' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
84' The Sassuolo players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
79' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
79' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sassuolo comes to nothing.
79' Sassuolo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
78' The corner is swung in but Sassuolo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
78' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Festy Ebosele as he is replaced by Adam Masina (Udinese).
77' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) picks up a yellow card.
75' 2 - 1 GOAL! Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) takes a real chance, but his penalty strike right into the middle of the net fools Marco Silvestri in goal.
75' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is going to take the penalty!
75' Referee Gianluca Manganiello is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Sassuolo!
75' Celebrations by Sassuolo are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.

74' One of the Udinese players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. The referee gives a penalty to Sassuolo after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
72' Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for an infringement.
72' Alessio Dionisi has decided to substitute Marcus Pedersen and he is replaced by Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo).
71' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hassane Kamara.
70' A quickly taken corner by Sassuolo.
67' Sassuolo are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sassuolo.
62' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
59' Martin Payero (Udinese) receives a red card due to his mindless behaviour. His team will now have to play with a man down.
56' That will be all from Daniel Boloca who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo).
55' 2 - 0 Goal! Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
54' Great teamplay by Sassuolo as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
52' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
51' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

50' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Sassuolo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

50' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Andrea Consigli is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
48' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) tries to find Festy Ebosele, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
47' Neat passing move from Sassuolo in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Gianluca Manganiello has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
44' The Sassuolo players are exchanging some short passes.
42' A cross from Martin Erlic (Sassuolo) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
40' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
39' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

36' 1 - 0 Goal! Roberto Pereyra hands Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
35' An attempted cross from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is cleared.
33' Udinese control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

33' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Gianluca Manganiello blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
32' The current number of shots on goal is 1:3.

31' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Marco Silvestri is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
28' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Udinese.
26' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
26' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball is out of play. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner.
23' Walace (Udinese) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.

22' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the middle of the goal. Marco Silvestri is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
22' Sassuolo work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
22' A lofted cross from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee signals a corner kick to Sassuolo.
21' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
20' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
20' This shall not pass! Festy Ebosele (Udinese) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
19' Martin Payero (Udinese) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
15' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Gianluca Manganiello stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
14' The Sassuolo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
13' Flag up against Hassane Kamara (Udinese). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
13' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
12' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
11' Udinese enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
10' The possession of the ball – 24:76.
8' The Sassuolo players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

7' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.

6' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is behind the touchline and Sassuolo will take a throw-in.
5' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
4' The resulting corner from Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is cleared by the defence.

4' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Sassuolo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
4' Sassuolo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
3' Sassuolo fail to score from a corner as Marco Silvestri (Udinese) leaps to collect the ball. Sassuolo have a corner.
1' Sassuolo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Udinese will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Gianluca Manganiello.
